quality: Good general quality. Behind Midjourney on aesthetics, behind Stable Diffusion on fine-grained control. The advantage is integration with the OpenAI ecosystem.
tagline: OpenAI's image generation model, available in ChatGPT and directly via the API.
use_cases: Image generation inside existing ChatGPT or API workflows
Rapid concept and placeholder image creation for content teams
Integrating image generation into an application via the OpenAI API
governance_note: The training-data provenance and synthetic-likeness questions apply here as they do across the image generation category. OpenAI does not offer the same commercial indemnity as Adobe. The integration convenience is the argument for it; indemnity and provenance are the arguments against, for regulated commercial use.
training_optout: OpenAI's commercial API terms apply. Consumer ChatGPT terms differ. Verify the terms for the tier in use.
